observations: Detailed and clean wordmarks are readable as tokkl at 640px; the o retains the clock counter and hands.
Clean and monochrome wordmarks remain readable at 160px. Use the standalone clock mark at icon sizes.
Independent Poppler PDF renders retain the letter forms, gradients and clock geometry.
Final contact sheet shows color variants on light and dark backgrounds, black on light, and white on dark with no clipping.
limitations: Detailed color and texture approximate the raster reference.
Single-ink artwork needs suitable background contrast.
Commercial printing requires the printer's CMYK or spot-color preparation.
